_comment: Reviewed licence exceptions. Every entry is DEV/BUILD-TIME ONLY: the Worker has zero runtime dependencies (npm ls --omit=dev is empty). Status of every entry is NEEDS REVIEW until counsel or the owners sign it off. Matching is by package name and exact licence string. A name ending in * matches any package with that prefix (platform-specific binaries differ per OS); the licence string must still match exactly.

exceptions.name: argparse
exceptions.reason: Permissive PSF-style licence, transitive dev tooling dependency, not distributed.

exceptions.name: caniuse-lite
exceptions.reason: Browser-support data used by build tooling. Attribution licence, not distributed.

exceptions.name: lightningcss
exceptions.reason: Transitive dependency of vite (test tooling). File-level copyleft, unmodified, not distributed.

exceptions.name: spdx-exceptions
exceptions.reason: Data package pulled in by licence tooling. Not distributed.

exceptions.name: spdx-ranges
exceptions.reason: Data package pulled in by licence tooling. Not distributed.

exceptions.name: @img/sharp-wasm32
exceptions.reason: Optional image library pulled in by Wrangler/Miniflare local dev. LGPL libvips. Dynamically linked, unmodified, never deployed to the Worker.

exceptions.name: lightningcss-*
exceptions.reason: Platform binaries of lightningcss (vite test tooling), one per OS and libc. Same reasoning as lightningcss.

exceptions.name: @img/sharp-*
exceptions.reason: Platform binaries of sharp for developer machines and CI runners. Dynamically linked, unmodified, never deployed to the Worker.

exceptions.name: @img/sharp-libvips-*
exceptions.reason: Platform builds of the LGPL libvips library used by sharp. Dev tooling only, unmodified, never deployed to the Worker.
